## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest solution implemented.

## Security impact

- Which scopes, tools or WordPress capabilities are affected?
- Does this alter authentication, confirmation, approval, backup or audit behavior?
- Why does the change remain fail-closed?

## Verification

- [ ] `bash scripts/test.sh` passes
- [ ] New or changed behavior has deterministic coverage
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, backups or private paths are included
- [ ] Admin changes were checked at desktop and mobile widths
- [ ] The release archive contains only installable plugin files

## Evidence

Include sanitized test output, screenshots or reproduction notes.
